snippet.title: TAYLOR SWIFT: Heute heiratet die Pop-Ikone und Travis Kelce in Manhatten! Promi-Hochzeit des Jahres!
snippet.description:
TAYLOR SWIFT: Heute heiratet die Pop-Ikone und Travis Kelce in Manhatten! Promi-Hochzeit des Jahres!

New York – Es ist die Promi-Hochzeit des Jahrzehnts – und Braut Taylor Swift (36) riegelt für das Liebesfest mit Travis Kelce (36) Teile von Manhattan ab! Einheiten des New York Police Departments patrouillieren, sogar Anti-Terroreinheiten und Spürhunde sind im Einsatz! Los ging es am Donnerstag mit einem Vorab-Dinner. Für Freitag haben Swift und Kelce dann 1000 Gäste in den Madison Square Garden eingeladen – die berühmte Sport- und Konzertarena wurde für den romantischen Anlass umfangreich umgestaltet.

WASHINGTON: Hier sollen 250 Jahre USA gefeiert werden, aber es sind kaum Gäste bei Trumps Mega-Event

Die USA feiern am Samstag den 250. Jahrestag ihrer Unabhängigkeit – mit Militärparaden, mehreren Reden von US-Präsident Donald Trump, Filmvorführungen, Musikdarbietungen, Militärkapellen, spektakulären Flugvorführungen und einer modernen Weltausstellung, „die die Menschen, Traditionen, Innovationen und den Geist feiert, die Amerika zur großartigsten Nation der Welt machen“, wie es in der Einladung zu den Feierlichkeiten heißt. Aber: Die USA haben Geburtstag, nicht das Weiße Haus!

16 Tage lang sollen das Land und seine Geschichte gefeiert werden. Doch das Interesse der Amerikaner hält sich in Grenzen.

snippet.title: Business Jet Crashes Onto Busy Highway After Both Engines Fail
snippet.description:
CONTEXT: On February 9, 2024, a Bombardier Challenger 604 aircraft registered as N823KD was preparing to land at Naples Airport in Florida after a flight from Ohio State University Airport in Columbus, Ohio when the aircraft suffered an apparent failure of both engines. The pilots then attempted a crash landing on I-75, as they were unable to reach the airport. The aircraft was owned by East Shore Aviation LLC and operated by Ace Aviation Services, doing business as Hop-A-Jet Worldwide Jet Charter (hence the callsign ‘Hop-A-Jet 823’). The aircraft had last underwent an airworthiness inspection just over a month earlier, on January 5. There were 5 people onboard flight 823, including 50-year-old Captain Edward Daniel Murphy and 65-year-old First Officer Ian Frederick Hofmann, both of whom were highly experienced aviators, with over 35,000 hours of flying experience between them. However First Officer Hofmann only had 138 hours flying Challenger 604 aircraft. Captain Murphy had 2,808. Also onboard was a flight attendant and two passengers. The cause of the crash is, as of publishing, still under investigation by the National Transportation Safety Board. As can be heard in the video, a suspected dual engine failure resulted in an inability to reach the airport. The pilots then attempted to land on a nearby highway. The aircraft struck 2 cars, injuring one person. The driver’s car was destroyed but miraculously the extent of their injuries were limited. The aircraft then burst into flames and the front section was destroyed. Both passengers and the flight attendant were injured, but able to run away from the wreckage following the crash. Unfortunately, both Captain Murphy and First Officer Hofmann died on the scene. The aircraft flight data recorders show that at 3:09:33 and 3:09:34 PM respectively, the left engine oil pressure and right engine oil pressure warnings activated, indicating critically low oil pressure in each engine. A red message, the illumination of the “Master Warning” light, and an audible alarm saying “Engine oil” alerted the pilots to the issue. At 3:09:40 PM, the engine master warning activates, indicating an abnormal condition in the fan rotor, compressor rotor, or inter-turbine temperature. Around 67 seconds later, the aircraft impacted Interstate 75.
